CAGNY investor presentation - no headline period results; platform used to articulate the transformation from a single-brand company into a three-brand 'total energy' / functional beverage platform.
2025 framed as a defining year - strategy validated after acquiring Alani Nu and Rockstar and strengthening the PepsiCo partnership.
Full portfolio now integrated into the PepsiCo DSD system at 99.5% ACV - a level of reach few brands can achieve.
Strategy framed around 'more people, more places, more often' and an ambition to move from big brands to mega brands with multi-occasion relevance.
Energy category has structurally shifted from a transactional impulse category to a lifestyle-driven one - zero sugar, functional benefits and alcohol-replacement now mega trends.
Zero sugar powers the majority of energy growth (85%); Celsius an early mover that helped define modern energy; CELH drives the largest share (33%) of zero-sugar category growth.
51% of category growth comes from increased frequency among existing consumers - energy becoming part of daily lifestyle and routine.
Female and Hispanic consumers key growth drivers; the modern-energy portfolio serves both routine-based consumption and impulse moments, growing with women while keeping a moat with men.
Three category-defining brands with clear roles: Celsius broad male/female appeal, Alani Nu female-focused, Rockstar core male and culture-driven users.
Rockstar requires a disciplined, phased approach - first stabilize performance, then improve execution, then sharpen positioning; adds incremental reach and long-term optionality.
Coming out of the 2026 resets management anticipates Celsius space gains over 17% and Alani Nu space gains over 100%, a significant portion from Convenience.
Convenience (~60% of energy sales) described as one of the biggest white space opportunities; also future opportunity across club, large format and small format.
Revenue growth management (RGM) - investments in data, tools and talent - positioned for a long-lasting foundational impact on profitable, sustainable growth, moving beyond volume to use price/mix.

Operating model 'must change' as the business scales with increasing complexity - managed as a portfolio with disciplined resource allocation and an execution-driven roadmap for higher-quality growth in 2026+.
Innovation built as a system, insights-led; recent Alani Cherry Bar sold out in a week; high-impact LTOs (Spritz Vibe, Limes) drive incrementality.
International a long-term growth opportunity with big runway - present in ~10 markets with a new Head of International; deliberate, select-market, resourced-launch approach.
Declining alcohol consumption opening social-occasion opportunity for energy.
PepsiCo partnership described as a true differentiator - stronger and more aligned than ever; tone optimistic, vision-led and emphatic about durability and execution discipline.
